sections.Profile:
The "Three Musketeers" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Fictional Character, Wood Rail, Horses, Original Theme, Adventure, Book
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Mabs
- Art: Roy Parker
sections.Editions: - Three Musketeers: 800 made, released 1949-07-01, model number 22
